concept: SNS: pub/sub fan-out to SQS and Lambda
tests: Which service implements pub/sub where one event is delivered to multiple independent subscribers.
expected: Amazon SNS topic with SQS, Lambda, HTTP subscribers (fan-out). Triggers: "publish/subscribe", "fans out to multiple independent consumers".
why_not: SQS alone — point-to-point; Step Functions — orchestration; Kinesis Data Streams — streaming data, not simple fan-out delivery.
